12. VC-25, VC-29, VC-34
Comment: Increase the averaging time for stripping from 24 hours to 30 days. With the 24 hour averaging time, a plant manager would have to balance production based on meeting the standard rather than on what customers had ordered.
Response: As stated in the preamble to the proposed standard, EPA rejected the option of extending the averaging time to a month because this would permit higher peak emission levels than averaging on a 24-hour basis. EPA has already provided the industry with considerable flexibility by allowing an averaging time of 24 hours.
